featured_reviews.name: Harsh Parte
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an excellent experience at Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital and Research Centre during my father’s bypass surgery treatment. Special thanks to Dr. Neeraj Kamat and his entire team for their exceptional treatment, guidance, and compassionate care throughout the journey. Their professionalism and support gave our family great confidence during a difficult time.

A heartfelt appreciation to the nursing staff, especially Nancy Dsouza, Akash, Nikita, and Deepali, for being extremely supportive, attentive, and caring at every step. Their kindness and dedication provided great comfort during the hospital stay.

Special thanks as well to the cleaning staff, especially Pawan Kumar and Barsa, for maintaining excellent hygiene and cleanliness and for their prompt support whenever needed.

One area where improvement is needed is visitor management and security coordination. The hospital has multiple levels of security checks — at the entrance, ground floor lift lobby, inside the lift area, and again on the patient floor. While security and patient safety are important, the process currently feels too strict and time-consuming for visitors. Visitor timings are already limited, and due to repeated checks and delays, a significant part of the allowed visiting time gets consumed. The hospital management may consider streamlining the process to make the visitor experience smoother while still maintaining safety standards.

Overall, highly thankful to the entire hospital team for their outstanding service and patient care.

Thanks,

Feedback on My Hospitalisation Experience at Bombay Hospital

I have been admitted to Bombay Hospital on a few occasions in the past as well — not because I am fond of hospitals, but because my health conditions at times make it necessary.

During my recent admission on the 30th, of April 2026 I was initially admitted to the Critical Care ICCU on the 3rd floor. It was an extremely busy and demanding environment throughout the five nights I spent there, yet the overall dedication and efficiency of the staff stood out. Despite the pressure they work under, the doctors, nurses, and support staff carried out their responsibilities with sincerity and professionalism.

I have now been shifted to the Neuro ICCU on the 5th floor, and I would especially like to appreciate Senior Sister Jyoti and Senior Sister Surekha for the way they manage and maintain the unit. The ICCU is extremely well maintained, clean, organised, and disciplined. Their leadership reflects positively in the functioning of the entire team. The nursing staff has been warm, attentive, and committed towards patient care, and it is evident that they take pride in their duties.

Like every institution, minor flaws or occasional mistakes may happen, and there is always scope for improvement amongst some of the support staff, ward boys, ward girls, and helping staff. However, it is equally important to acknowledge the larger picture — the effort, compassion, and dedication shown daily by the nursing teams and medical staff under challenging circumstances.

Over the years, I have personally seen many nurses grow from trainees into confident and capable professionals handling immense responsibilities with maturity and experience. That growth deserves appreciation and encouragement.

I sincerely wish the entire team continued success and growth in their careers. May they keep evolving, learning, and rising further in their profession while continuing to provide compassionate care to patients and families who depend on them during difficult times.

I remain grateful and thankful for the care and support extended to me.

Hiren Mehta

featured_reviews.review_text:
Cama and Albless Hospital (also called Pestonji Cama & Albless Hospital) is a long-established government hospital in Mumbai that specialises in healthcare for women and children. It is one of the city’s key public referral centres in these areas and operates under the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC).

Location
Address: Mahapalika Marg, opposite Azad Maidan, Dhobi Talao, near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Fort, Mumbai 400001, Maharashtra, India.

The hospital is centrally located and easily accessible by train, bus and taxi from across the city.

History & Capacity
The hospital was founded in 1886, making it one of Mumbai’s oldest public healthcare institutions.

It originally started as Cama Hospital and was later renamed Cama and Albless Hospital.

Current bed capacity is around 500+ beds dedicated to women’s and children’s care.

Primary Focus and Services
Healthcare for Women and Children:

Maternity care, high-risk pregnancies and obstetrics

Gynaecology including specialised clinics such as urogynaecology
Paediatric care and neonatal services

Low-cost or subsidised treatment as a public hospital for eligible patients

Oncology and Advanced Care:
The hospital runs an oncology wing with chemotherapy and related services focused on cancers common in women.

Radiation therapy services have been modernised with a linear accelerator machine to provide targeted treatment free of charge for cancer patients, a significant upgrade in public cancer care.

Reproductive Health and ART:
The hospital offers assisted reproductive technology (ART) services, including IVF. Since May 2024 these services have been made available free of cost under the state health insurance scheme for eligible patients, making it the first public hospital in Maharashtra to do so.

In late 2025 it became the first public hospital in the state authorised to provide egg freezing and sperm bank services as part of its ART programme.

Other Developments:
The hospital is adding educational programs such as a postgraduate diploma in oncology nursing to support cancer care training.

A Centre of Excellence for Women’s Pelvic Health has opened to treat urogynaecological conditions, with modern diagnostics and clinic rooms.

Teaching & Referral Role
Cama and Albless Hospital also functions as a teaching and research hospital linked with Grant Medical College and is part of a network of public hospitals that train doctors and healthcare professionals.

Community Role

It serves a wide patient base from Mumbai and nearby districts, offering emergency care 24/7 and referral services for specialised women’s and children’s health needs at subsidised costs.

🌟Cama & Albless Hospital 🌟

Cama and Albless Hospital, located near Mumbai’s CST area, is one of the city’s oldest and most respected government hospitals, especially known for women’s and children’s healthcare. Established in the late 19th century, it has served generations of families with dedication and compassion.

Strengths
- Specialized Care: The hospital is focused on maternity, gynecology, and pediatric services, making it a trusted institution for women and children.
- Affordability: As a government hospital, the cost of treatment is minimal compared to private hospitals. For the fees charged, the services provided can feel like 5‑star value.
- Experienced Staff: Many doctors and nurses here have decades of experience, and their commitment to serving patients is evident.
- Legacy & Accessibility: Centrally located near CST, it is easily accessible to people across Mumbai.

Limitations
- Infrastructure: Being a government hospital, facilities may not match the luxury or comfort of private hospitals. If one expects a 5‑star ambience, it may feel closer to 2‑star.
- Crowding & Wait Times: Like most public hospitals, it can be crowded, and patients may face longer waiting periods.

Overall Impression
Cama and Albless Hospital is a heritage institution that continues to provide essential healthcare to women and children at highly affordable costs. While it may not offer the polished environment of private hospitals, the value for money and the dedication of its staff make it a lifeline for countless families.

The lab technicians, doctors and the support staff were very kind and helpful. They patiently answered any queries I had and guided me properly. The receptionist Yamini was very nice and welcomed me with a smile, which helped in reducing my anxiety when I entered the center. You need a good supportive environment when you go for medical tests because health anxiety (especially post Covid) is usually high and having such a calm space where you don't feel rushed and people are supportive and patient with you really helps. I had that experience at Eva diagnostics and I would definitely recommend Eva diagnostics to others. Thanks a ton to everyone at Eva for making my journey smoother!

featured_reviews.name: Janki Miles
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent visit to Eva healthcare. It ticked all the boxes in terms of the diagnostic priorities for me. From the moment of arrival to departure, there was a personal touch. Vanita, at reception provided exceptional customer service and she was lovely and friendly. A real asset to the company. Through my 3-4 hours stay, I dealt with trained professionals who put me at ease even during uncomfortable tests and were knowledgeable about their subject matter. The equipment was modern and clean, the space was calm, quiet and privacy was maintained at all times. Timings were well managed so I didn’t queue for anything. A very good experience which I would be happy to recommend to friends and family. The only reason for not giving 5 stars is that I think it could do with a bit of a facelift - it’s very spacious but could brighter. Rohini also took time to take my personal feedback, which showed they take customer experience seriously. I will definitely book again.

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Prashant Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
On Sunday, 18th January, I decided to visit EVA in Bangalore, part of NM Medical, located opposite Leela Palace.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by warm, welcoming faces who promptly confirmed my details and the tests I had opted for. There was no waiting at all—I was seamlessly guided to my blood tests. The experience was surprisingly comfortable; the lady drawing my blood kept me engaged in a pleasant conversation, frequently checking if I was okay. Thanks to her calm and caring approach, I didn’t even realise when five vials were drawn—without a moment of anxiety.

Post this, I was guided for my sonography (abdomen and pelvic area) and mammography. The doctor was extremely gentle, patient, and explained things clearly, which instantly put me at ease.

Once the tests were done, I was escorted to a beautifully set-up breakfast area within the lab. Never before have I experienced a healthy, thoughtfully curated breakfast at a diagnostic centre. This was also when I had a conversation with the Head of the Centre, who genuinely wanted to understand how my experience had been so far.

The final test was the mammogram—something I had always been apprehensive about. However, my experience at EVA completely changed that perception. The technician was exceptionally gentle, constantly checking on my comfort and ensuring there was no distress. That long-standing fear is now truly gone.

Overall, it was a wonderful, seamless experience—completely unlike the usual diagnostic centres where waiting, confusion, and follow-ups are the norm. EVA has truly redefined what a healthcare experience can feel like.

featured_reviews.name: HB
featured_reviews.review_text: As an NRI, living in a country that doesn't provide any preventive care or diagnostics, coming to NM Eva has been a great find. Their services are top notch, and their tests are very comprehensive. Right from full profile blood tests, to ECGs and Ultrasounds, to Bone density and fat analysis (both crucial for women), this place is a one stop shop for all diagnostic women care. What's even better is their impeccable service and hygiene, economical packages, and the safety of being an all women centre makes this a great choice for women looking for diagnostic care. Their centre is stress free and a far cry from the stress and chaos of hospitals. 100% recommended, especially if you live outside India and are unable to find medical professionals who are interested in your preventive care woes. Thank you Rohini and Vanita and all the lovely staff their for their attention and care.
